narrative: Flowise CVE-2026-40933 is at core a disclosure-process story: fixed in 3.1.0 via maintainer-coordinated disclosure with Obsidian publishing proof-of-concept code, and the flaw mapped against the NSA Model Context Protocol information sheet. A second CVSS-9-plus agent-framework RCE handled this way in successive weeks is the repeated practice that pushes toward a shared disclosure standard.
remaining_gap: No formal common disclosure-format standard, and no peer-lab cohort programs at the predicted scale, have yet been published.
